<?php
function warning177($severity177, $message177) {
    global $left177, $right177, $warnings177;
    ++$warnings177;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings177, ':', $message177, '|';
    $left177 = 41;
    $right177 = 42;
    return true;
}
function receive177(int $first177, int $second177) {
    echo 'body:', $first177, ':', $second177, ':', $GLOBALS['left177'], ':', $GLOBALS['right177'], '|';
    return $first177 + $second177;
}
set_error_handler('warning177');
$left177 = 1.5;
$right177 = 2.5;
$warnings177 = 0;
$got177 = receive177($left177, $right177);
echo 'used:', $got177, ':', $left177, ':', $right177, '|';
$left177 = 1.5;
$right177 = 2.5;
$warnings177 = 0;
receive177($left177, $right177);
echo 'ignored:', $left177, ':', $right177, '|';
purpose: Both SEND snapshots precede ordered receives: diagnostic1.5 then2.5 and formals1/2 survive caller global41/42 mutation in used and ignored calls.

<?php
function warning177($severity177, $message177) {
    global $left177, $right177, $warnings177, $original177;
    ++$warnings177;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings177, ':', $message177, '|';
    $left177 = 41;
    $right177 = 42;
    if ($warnings177 === 2) { throw $original177; }
    return true;
}
function receive177(int $first177, int $second177) {
    echo 'body|';
    return $first177 + $second177;
}
$original177 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning177');
$left177 = 1.5;
$right177 = 2.5;
$warnings177 = 0;
$destination177 = 91;
try { $destination177 = receive177($left177, $right177); }
catch (Throwable $caught177) {
    echo 'caught:', (int)($caught177 === $original177), ':', (int)($caught177->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination177, ':', $left177, ':', $right177, '|';
}
purpose: First int receive completes before the second precision handler throws the original Exception. The body/result assignment are skipped; originalE/PreviousNULL and caller41/42 survive.
expected_normal_stdout: warning:1:Implicit conversion from float 1.5 to int loses precision|warning:2:Implicit conversion from float 2.5 to int loses precision|caught:1:1:91:41:42|

<?php
function warning177($severity177, $message177) {
    global $source177, $throw177, $original177;
    echo 'warning:', $message177, '|';
    $source177 = 41;
    if ($throw177) { throw $original177; }
    return true;
}
function receive177(int $first177, int $second177) {
    echo 'body|';
    return $first177 + $second177;
}
$original177 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning177');
$source177 = 1.5;
$throw177 = false;
$destination177 = 91;
try { $destination177 = receive177($source177); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught177) { echo 'missing:', $destination177, ':', $source177, '|'; }
$source177 = 1.5;
$throw177 = true;
try { $destination177 = receive177($source177); }
catch (Throwable $caught177) {
    echo 'caught:', (int)($caught177 === $original177), ':', (int)($caught177->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination177, ':', $source177, '|';
}
purpose: Provided first-parameter precision reception precedes a missing second required argument; a handler exception wins before that arity error and remains original without Previous.
